subject.name: Saint Jerome, Priest and Doctor of the Church
subject.subtitle: c. 347–420
subject.blurb: Dalmatian scholar who learned Hebrew so that he could translate the Bible into Latin from the original rather than from the Greek, producing the Vulgate that the Western Church read for the next thousand years. He spent his last thirty-four years in a monastery at Bethlehem, writing commentaries and letters of famous asperity.
